messages:
ana_sales: Tracking BlueHarbor Bank POC asks: BYO-HSM with attestation, KEK rotation SLA 7 days, and pricing comparison (flat premium vs per-HSM-op). Also request for pen-test window and DR drill.

kevin_se: Clarify: do they require per-request HSM unwrap for all sensitive flows? That will affect latency.

client_infosec: For prod, yes. Pilot can use cached unwraps for up to 1 hour. Need KMIP support and mutual TLS. FIPS 140-2 L3 preferred.

marie_sec: Pen-test window: 30 days external with 72h notice. We'll require scoped endpoints and a signed attestation chain on onboarding. Add audit retention 12 months in SOW.

oscar_ops: Ops note: per-request unwrap will add ~90-140ms p99. Weekly rotation doable with staged rewrap and 24h fallback to previous KEK. For 7-day rotation we recommend prefix caching TTL <= 15m.

billing_team: Ballpark: reserved base $20k/mo. BYO-HSM premium +20% (~$4k/mo). Per-op surcharge option ~$0.0006/op. One-time onboarding fee ~$22k.

ana_sales: Action items: Kevin to draft SOW addendum, Marie to confirm attestation checklist, Billing to provide formal quote, Oscar to prepare runbook draft. Sync tomorrow 9:30am PT.

client_infosec: We'll provide attestations and network allowlist by EOD. Please include clause for DR drill and remediation credits.

marie_sec: We'll propose a remediation SLA for missed rotation windows except when caused by customer HSM maintenance.

ana_sales: Thanks all. Ping me for blockers. :thumbsup:
